about_the_game:
FANTASTICO is the long-awaited sequel to the 1983-style smash arcade hit Donut Dodo!

The goofy bird returns to treat Dodo Junior to a whirlwind day at the vintage funfair - a delightful outing packed with spinning rides, wild attractions, and enough donuts to hit the sweet spot!

But wait! Baker Billy Burns is here to make a mess of things and grab every last donut before little Junior can get those wings sticky!

Donut Dodo FANTASTICO is a single-screen arcade platformer inspired by the golden age of gaming. You’ll run, climb, jump, and scramble through colorful stages - dodging enemies, bouncing through hazards, and snatching up donuts before time runs out.

Each stage is a quick, skill-based challenge designed for short and sweet play sessions - whether you’ve got 3 minutes or 30, there’s always time for “just one more run.”

We’re going back to 1983, again, with:

  • 6 unique funfair-themed stages and all-new attraction-based mechanics

  • Tight, precise controls tailored for single-player arcade action

  • Multiple secrets and alternate endings based on skill and progression

  • Local and global high-score leaderboards, arcade-style

  • Glorious CRT-friendly pixel art with a vibrant 16-color palette

  • Authentic high energy chiptune soundtrack

  • No continues - each run is a fresh chance to climb the leaderboard!


Oh, and yes… Stinky the rogue toilet is back!
